description: Canonical machine context for Arden and other AI tools. Not a visual roadmap copy: short contract of version, hard architecture rules, accepted work, and next actions.

architectureRules.rule: createExpense() is the only production entry point for new expenses
Training mode requires explicit user confirmation for every new expense; Assistant mode is not enabled
Ledger accounts are the source of truth for money on accounts; funds and plans are not reconciliation targets
Funds are allocation of own money, not accounts
Credit limit is not own money and is not a fund
fundId on an expense is optional
Personal and Business wallets remain separate ledgers with different fields
AI proposes and ranks; the user decides duplicates and confirmations

accepted.item: Store searchable combobox and merchant learning prep
Expense entry from Personal and Business

accepted.note: User verified: empty category on add-expense, «з» does not match «Жура», oz→Ozon still works
User verified: Valet report toggles, account reconciliation age/date, LLM greeting off, funds/credit CRUD
User verified Valet learning admin page opens

inProgress.note: Only env variable names exist locally; secrets are never published here

doNotDoNow: separate bridge project beyond this JSON
nextActions: Create the next stable release checkpoint (git)
Later: receipts as sourceOperation through LLM and Gateway
Later: merchantId / Assistant / full Valet — after checkpoint
focus: Do not add major new features; stabilize the current version first

sync.forArden: At the start of a Wallet discussion, fetch this JSON (contextVersion) and treat architectureRules as hard constraints. Use the roadmap for human detail. Chat never overrides this file.
